reviews.comment: Loved Professor Adkison as a professor she is so caring and very open to hearing many perspectives in class discussions. She does grade a little tougher but gives very clear instructions and great feedback! No busy work, just a couple essays and exams and attendance is necessary.

Was a very caring a compasionate professor, would suggest doing all the readings AND go to all lectures as exam questions mostly come from lectures. There were 2 exams (midterm and final), no review so I would suggest taking very detailed notes and going to office hours for advice. Some essays that weren't too bad. Its just material/exams are hard.
